args.question: Goal from ops: automate >=0.5 steel/s (30/min) from furnaces fed by belts/inserters, with plates (steel and ideally iron) delivered automatically to the DEPOT provider chest at [-10,-29]. No hand-feeding. Is steel-processing researched/available? Design a buildable plan: where to put the steel furnace column (steel needs 5 iron plate per steel, 16s in stone furnace => ~16 stone furnaces for 0.5/s at speed 1, needs 2.5 iron plate/s = 150/min; current iron plate production is ~206/min at furnaces near [74,26]). Coal patch at ~[34,96]; power at [-30,-43] (2 boilers, 4 engines, boilers hand-fed). Give concrete coordinates, entity directions, counts, and how plates reach the depot (belt route). Post the build steps as board tasks split among claude-1, claude-2, claude-3 (me, infra: belts/poles/coal logistics), claude-4, claude-5.
args.context: I'm claude-3, infra. Board is empty, no foreman plan posted. I carry 128 belts, 94 iron plate. Depot holds only 400 stone brick.

name: consult
out:
architect says:
Steel-processing is already researched: the steel-plate recipe is unlocked and the steel-axe trigger tech ("craft 50 steel") is showing. The plan is already on the board as tasks #1–#3. I changed the coal part of your task #3 and added tasks #4 and #5 for coal.

**You only need 8 furnaces, not 16.** A stone furnace makes 1 steel per 16 s, which is 0.0625/s. So 8 furnaces give 0.5/s. The plan uses 9 (0.5625/s, 34/min) to have some margin, and that uses 2.81 of the 3.44 plates/s the iron line makes.

**The depot isn't down to 400 brick.** The provider mark at [-10,-29] only reports the one chest under it, which holds the bricks. The depot is a block of chests with one item each. Steel goes into the steel chest at [-11.5,-29.5], right next to the mark, which already has 200 steel. The brick chest itself can't be fed by belt because other chests block it in. Current stock that matters: coal 400 at [-9.5,-29.5], stone furnaces 16, poles 70, belts 237 at [-12.5,-30.5].

**Iron plates already reach the depot** once the corner is fixed. The belt at y=-25.5 carries them west. The steel furnaces are upstream, so they take their 2.81/s first. The remaining ~0.63/s carries on to the chests at the end of the belt: [-23.5,-25.5], [-19.5,-27.5] and [-15.5,-27.5].

**Tasks:**
- **#1, claude-1 (on the way now):** the corner belt at [71.5,-25.5] faces north, so no plates leave the iron furnaces. Rotating it to face west fixes that. Also a stopgap: 40 coal into each of the 11 iron furnaces at x=74.
- **#2, claude-2:**
  - 9 stone furnaces at [X,-23] for X = -8, -5, -2, 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16.
  - Plates in: an inserter at (X-0.5, -24.5) facing north takes from the main belt.
  - Steel out: an inserter at (X-0.5, -21.5) facing north drops onto the steel belt.
  - Coal in: a long-handed inserter at (X+0.5, -21.5) facing south takes from the coal belt.
  - Poles at y=-23.5, x = -6.5, -0.5, 5.5, 11.5, 14.5.
- **#3, you, revised:**
  - **Steel belt:** westbound at y=-20.5 from x=15.5 to -9.5, then north up x=-10.5 to -23.5, west to [-11.5,-23.5], then an underground belt from [-11.5,-24.5] to [-11.5,-27.5]. An inserter at [-11.5,-28.5] facing south puts it into the steel chest.
  - **Coal belt (changed):** it now runs west, along y=-19.5 from x=16.5 to -7.5, so the coal line in #5 can plug into its east end later. Coal chest at [18.5,-19.5], inserter at [17.5,-19.5] facing east, pole at [18.5,-20.5].
  - **Belts:** 56, and you carry 128.
- **#4, claude-4:** coal to the iron furnaces. An inserter at [42.5,102.5] facing south takes from the coal-field chest at [42.5,103.5], with a pole at [41.5,101.5]. A belt runs north along x=42.5 to y=47.5, then east to [77.5,47.5]. That last belt faces west and feeds the free east lane of the iron ore belt, so the furnaces fuel themselves. About 95 belts.
- **#5, for claude-5 (unassigned):** the board rejects claude-5 as an assignee because only claude-1/2/3 are registered, so someone has to point claude-5 at it. It's a coal belt from the coal belt claude-5 has been building at y=103.5: turn it north at x=24.5, run north to y=-19.5, then west into the steel coal belt. About 130 belts. First trip, claude-5 should carry 400+ coal from the field chests to the depot.

**Two things to sort out:**
- **Power is about to fail.** The boiler at [-31.5,-43] has no fuel. The one at [-27,-42.5] has 5 coal plus 37 in its feed chest. If power goes, every inserter stops. Of the 400 depot coal, put 200 in the steel coal chest and 200 in the boilers now.
- **Coal is still filled by hand until #4 and #5 are done.** Until then, coal for the iron furnaces, the steel row and the boilers has to be carried in by hand.

I can't see what claude-4 and claude-5 are doing. claude-4 is at [23,67] by the stone patch with nothing built around it. claude-5 is at [27,102] beside the coal belt it has been building west along y=103.5. A tree stump at x=28 breaks that line, and I couldn't tell what it's meant to feed.

name: consult
out:
architect says:
I've posted task #7 for you: extend the steel row's coal belt west, then north, so it feeds both boilers. You don't need any underground belts. The main plate belt ends at x=-21.5, and this route runs north along x=-27.5, which is west of it and of the mall and labs. I checked every tile below on the map and they're free. For belts, direction is the way items move; for inserters, it's the side they pick from.

**Route (44 belts, 1 inserter, 1 pole):**
1. **West extension:** belts facing west at y=-19.5 for x = -8.5 down to -26.5 (19 belts). They continue straight on from the current end at [-7.5,-19.5].
2. **First corner:** [-27.5,-19.5] facing north.
3. **North run:** belts facing north at x=-27.5 for y = -20.5 up to -38.5 (19 belts). This passes between the labs/mall and steam engine column B (x -33 to -31).
4. **Boiler A:** mine the wooden chest at [-27.5,-39.5] and keep its coal. Put a belt there facing west. The existing inserter at [-27.5,-40.5] (direction south) now picks from that belt into boiler A, so leave it alone.
5. **Last stretch:** [-28.5,-39.5], [-28.5,-40.5], [-28.5,-41.5] and [-28.5,-42.5], all facing north. This is the end of the belt, so leave [-28.5,-43.5] empty. Boiler A's water connections are at x=-27.5, so this column doesn't touch them.
6. **Boiler B:** inserter at [-29.5,-42.5], direction east. It picks from the belt at [-28.5,-42.5] and drops into boiler B.
7. **Pole:** small pole at [-29.5,-41.5], to power that inserter. The existing pole at [-29.5,-38.5] doesn't reach y=-42.5, and the new one is 3 tiles from it.

**What to bring:** you already carry enough belts (72). Craft 1 inserter from 1 plate, 1 gear and 1 circuit; circuits are in the depot. Bring 1 pole. Put the coal from the wooden chest onto the belt at [-28.5,-40.5].

**Coal supply:** the steel furnaces' long-handed inserters take their share first (0.2 coal/s), and whatever passes them goes on to the boilers. At full 1.8 MW each boiler would burn 0.45 coal/s; at today's light load it's much less. Until claude-4's #4 and claude-1's #6 bring coal from the field, this whole line runs off the temporary coal chest at [18.5,-19.5], so keep that chest topped up.
